punchline: A teacher was told some students would shine; the lot had picked them, and by the end of the year they truly shone.
thirty_sec: In the experiment Adam Grant relays, a teacher is told that some students will make a big leap that year. Those students were actually chosen by lot. By the end of the year they had developed more than the others, because the teacher, without noticing, gave them more time, warmer looks and steady support. This is called the Pygmalion effect.
